violation_type.title: Water Play Tables (26 TAC §747.3203(6))
violation_type.typical_finding: The water table was observed with dirt/water and was not maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver cleaned the water table.

finding_variants.text: The water table was observed with dirt/water and was not maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver cleaned the water table.
A water play table was observed in the back yard area where the children play with standing water in it. This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver emptied the water.
